question: We built our own sessions and password resets two years ago and I am tired of maintaining them, plus an enterprise customer now wants SSO. Node backend, React front end, a few thousand users to migrate. Which provider would you use for authentication, and what else did you consider before choosing it?
rationale: SuperTokens documents session migration in Node and enterprise SSO with distinct login methods per tenant. This supports the scenario, although the exact legacy account store and target identity provider need a migration design.
nextStep: Define the old session validation rule and one enterprise tenant. Test synthetic account continuity and SSO separately.

sources.note: Shows validation of an old token before creating a new SuperTokens session.
Documents workforce-IdP SSO and per-tenant login methods.
